_ssmPathHelp: Change 'hierarchy' to your existing Parameter Store path (must end with /). Or set env SSM_PARAMETERS_HIERARCHY for configure + cdk without editing this file. Parameter names after the prefix must match: cognitoDomainPrefix, connectInstanceURL, bedrockRegion, novaSonicModelId, etc.

parameters.name: cognitoDomainPrefix
parameters.description: Amazon Cognito hosted UI domain prefix, where users will be redirected during the login process. The domain prefix has to be unique, between 1 and 63 characters long, contains no special characters, and no keywords: aws, amazon, or cognito. You could put your Amazon Connect Instance Alias to it, for example: connect-v2v-instance-alias

parameters.name: cognitoCallbackUrls
parameters.description: Please provide a callback URL for the Amazon Cognito authorization server to call after users are authenticated. This should be set to your application root URL. For example: https://aaaabbbbcccc.cloudfront.net

parameters.name: cognitoLogoutUrls
parameters.description: Please provide a logout URL where user is to be redirected after logging out.

parameters.name: connectInstanceURL
parameters.description: Amazon Connect instance URL that solution will use. For example: https://connect-instance-alias.my.connect.aws (or https://connect-instance-alias.awsapps.com)

parameters.name: connectInstanceRegion
parameters.description: Amazon Connect instance Region that solution will use. For example: us-east-1

parameters.name: bedrockRegion
parameters.description: AWS Region for Amazon Bedrock (Nova Sonic). Must match a Region where amazon.nova-2-sonic-v1:0 is available, for example: us-east-1

parameters.name: novaSonicModelId
parameters.description: Bedrock model ID for Nova Sonic bidirectional speech (default amazon.nova-2-sonic-v1:0)

parameters.name: transcribeRegion
parameters.description: AWS Region for Amazon Transcribe streaming, for example: us-east-1. Leave not-defined to use bedrockRegion.

parameters.name: translateRegion
parameters.description: AWS Region for Amazon Translate (fallback translation), for example: us-east-1. Leave not-defined to use bedrockRegion.

parameters.name: pollyRegion
parameters.description: AWS Region for Amazon Polly (fallback speech), for example: us-east-1. Leave not-defined to use bedrockRegion.

parameters.name: ssoEnabled
parameters.description: true = the web app skips the Cognito sign-in page and goes straight to the SSO provider (ssoProviderName). false = show the Cognito sign-in page. The provider itself is configured in the Cognito console.

parameters.name: ssoProviderName
parameters.description: Cognito SAML identity provider name, exactly as shown in the Cognito console, for example: EntraID. Used only when ssoEnabled is true.

parameters.name: translationEnabled
parameters.description: true = agents can use voice translation (Amazon Bedrock Nova Sonic, Transcribe, Translate, Polly). false = the webapp is a plain softphone: the Customer, Agent and Transcription panels are greyed out, no proxy is deployed and no role gets Bedrock, Transcribe, Translate or Polly permissions; the CCP, Customer Information and Audio Controls work as usual. Required, with no default: every environment must choose. Changing it takes a deploy (npm run build:deploy:all); open pages then ask agents to reload between calls.

parameters.name: proxyEnabled
parameters.description: Used only when translationEnabled is true. true = deploy the server-side proxy (ECS Fargate behind CloudFront) and route every Bedrock, Transcribe, Translate and Polly call through it, so no AWS credentials ever reach the browser; the Cognito identity pool role then gets no permissions. false = the browser calls AWS directly with identity pool credentials.

parameters.name: proxyAllowedGroups
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated Cognito group names, for example V2V-Connect-Agents. When set, the proxy only serves users in at least one of these groups. Leave not-defined to serve every user of the user pool.

parameters.name: proxyAvailabilityZones
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated names of exactly 2 Availability Zones for the proxy, for example us-east-1a,us-east-1b. CloudFront VPC origins do not support every AZ (in us-east-1 not AZ ID use1-az3), and AZ names map to different AZ IDs in each account. Leave not-defined to use the first 2 AZs.

parameters.name: cspEnforced
parameters.description: false = the webapp's Content Security Policy is sent report-only: the browser console lists what it would block, nothing is blocked. true = the policy is enforced. Run test calls in report-only mode first, and enforce once the console shows no Content Security Policy reports.
